fact: Malawi's Parliament passed an amendment to the existing Payment Systems Act on Thursday 6 August 2026, removing cheque provisions, so the Act is already law; the Finance Minister said detailed regulations would follow (report dated 2026-08-07).
The Reserve Bank of Malawi issued licence PSP-003/26 under the Payment Systems Act, 2016, per Malawi24.
Under the Payment Systems Act, 2016 the Reserve Bank of Malawi licensed local fintech PayChangu Limited as a payment service provider, per Malawi24.
The deck lists the Payment Systems Act, 2022 (a revision of the 2011 act) and the E-Money Regulation, 2019 among the supporting legal frameworks.
